title: Kursi Dekat Jendela
subject: a fifteen-year-old in Malang on the first morning of kelas sepuluh who sprints from the school gate to grab the back seat by the window, only to find the girl from his junior high already sitting there with her bag on the other chair, saved for him
caption: Indonesian alternative pop anthem in the style of the 2020s indie-alt scene. Driving eighth-note electric guitars with chorus pedal, punchy live drums with tom-heavy build into each chorus, round synth bass, a glockenspiel melody line, gang-vocal 'hey' shouts on the downbeats. Big airy mix, festival-ready, slight room reverb. Bright male mid-register vocal, conversational in verses, belted in the choruses. 134 BPM, G major. Mood of a breathless first day turning into a grin. No EDM drop, no trap hi-hats, no autotune, no pop-punk palm-mute chug, no ballad breakdown.
lyrics:
[Intro - glockenspiel melody, drums count in]
[Verse 1]
Gerbang dibuka jam enam lewat
Tas di punggung, aku lari
Lewat kantin, lewat lapangan
Kelas sepuluh, lantai dua
[Pre-Chorus]
Tangga ini terlalu panjang
Jangan ada yang duluan
[Chorus]
Kursi dekat jendela
Paling belakang, itu punyaku
Satu tahun lihat pohon jambu
Asal guru nggak tahu
[Verse 2]
Pintu kubuka, napas habis
Ternyata kamu sudah di sana
Teman SMP, rambut dikuncir
Tasmu jagain kursi sebelah
[Chorus]
Kursi dekat jendela
Kamu bilang, "Ini buat kamu"
Satu tahun lihat pohon jambu
Sekarang ada yang lebih seru
[Outro - gang vocals, guitars ring out]
Bel masuk bunyi, aku duduk
Kelas sepuluh, mulai sekarang
